summary: Iteration 130 regression pass after code-review refactor fixes. Backend 10/10 pytest cases pass (rewards entries batch, vote toggle atomic, public status/salon_on, super/tenant participants entries, auth profile notify_email+instagram, login-email wrong-password 400, growth-advisory ledger progress). Frontend HQ profile card shows notify_email + @instagram, Edit Profile modal contains all 4 new inputs (notify email, instagram, login email, login password), Save updates header instagram (@miracurl.official → reverted to @miracurl.suite), Tenants tab renders rewards-campaign-card with no scheduled warning (campaign live) and 2 inbox-health badges. Public /rewards/miracurl-marathahalli renders header, models, vote gallery and apply form (no 'Casting opens' banner since live).
critical_code_review_comments: _entries_batch keyed by tenant_id + participant_id — good perf improvement over per-row lookups; ensure indexes on rewards_entries (tenant_id, participant_id) exist (ensure_rewards_indexes covers this).
public_vote delete-then-insert with DuplicateKeyError tolerance is a pragmatic atomicity substitute; consider MongoDB transaction if replica set is guaranteed, otherwise leave as-is.
public_applicants rate limit (120/10min per IP) is reasonable for public traffic; keep an eye on shared-IP office/campus environments.
growth_advisory ledger correctly filters to scheduled/completed and caps at 12 — matches request.
Super-admin login email change requires current_password + returns 400 on mismatch — solid; recommend logging failed attempts for audit.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (HQ profile card + modal + tenants tab + public rewards page)
